title: Near-death experience after poisoning: out-of-body travel and white light

tellings.quote: was delivered DOA to a clinic in pasel Germany from Austria and uh I had not had a heartbeat for almost 40 minutes

plain: In 1970, after being poisoned in Austria, a guest named Joe McMoneagle says he was delivered dead on arrival to a clinic in Germany, at a town he names as Passau, and had no heartbeat for almost 40 minutes. He tells it as his own experience: while he was gone, he says, he traveled outside his body and saw a white light.
